Subject: QBR prep: account-by-account sprint and forecast convergence

Team —

We need a compact, account-by-account sprint to close out forecast gaps for the QBR. Acme is the highest-variance account in region US this quarter (RC forecast shows a $420k delta). Goals for this thread: align on owner actions, collect an account one-pager per owner, and consolidate a single forecast CSV that matches the exec deck.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you lead the Acme account one-pager and attach the updated MATP (milestones, asks, timelines, path to close)?
- Neha: please reconcile bookings cadence vs. finance numbers and drop the consolidated CSV in Drive (I put a starter template).
- Marcus: confirm any technical gating that could shift timing by >2 weeks.

Deadline: please have the one-pager + updated forecast in Drive by EOD Thu (2027-11-04). I will consolidate and run a quick readout with Tessa on Mon.

Notes to include on the one-pager: recent PoC outcomes, procurement blockers, SOC/compliance asks, and the proposed cut (if any) to meet ARR targets. Keep it one page, bullets only.

Thanks —
Rachel

- Current ask: $1.1M ARR expansion tied to model hosting and dedicated capacity.
- Risk: procurement has a legal review queued; expected 7 business day delay unless we provide the requested data retention artifact.
- Tech blocker: minor KV-cache tuning needed for performance tests (Marcus, will need your sign-off).

Attached: ACME_QBR_MATP.xlsx (contains milestones and vendor contact matrix). I'll fill the one-pager into the Drive template and flag any blind spots.

Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for the update and the MATP. A couple quick clarifications from our side before the QBR:
- Procurement will need a copy of the SOC2 artifact (or confirmation of attestation date) to move legal review forward.
- On billing terms: Acme prefers net-60 with milestone-based invoices; can Redwood accommodate that for the first year?
- We have a preferred signing flow via DocuSign — we'll send the SOW back with comments by EOD Monday.

We are aiming for a mid-November go-live but procurement timing is the gating factor. Attaching a short note from our procurement lead (see below).

Procurement note: "If Redwood can provide SOC2 Type II timeline and confirm that data retention will be configurable per our policy, we can shorten legal review. Otherwise legal will require a 3-week lead time."
